test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Vague
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3 i.e. 'Definite'.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**Vague**' means not clearly expressed, known, described, or decided. 

 
 
• **Example**: His explanations were vague and confusing, leaving everyone uncertain of his intentions.
 
 
 
• The word '**Definite**' means clearly stated or decided; not vague or doubtful. 
 
 
• **Example**: She had a definite idea of how she wanted the project to go.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- **Definite**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Elegant **means graceful and stylish in appearance or manner.

 
 
• **Example**: She wore an elegant dress to the gala.
 
 
 
• **Regal **means of, resembling, or fit for a monarch, especially in being magnificent or dignified.
 
 
• **Example**: The regal palace was a sight to behold with its grand architecture.
 
 
 
• **Dwarf **means a person of unusually short stature; the term is also used metaphorically to refer to anything much smaller than the usual size.
 
 
• **Example**: The old apple tree was a dwarf compared to the towering oaks surrounding it.
